analysis:
The PR is documentation-only: one added row in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head line 1751) that documents the env var DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SHAPE_WARMUP (disables load-time shape warmup with 0, or skips its shader-cache probe with 'always'). The supplied base text (lines 1-830) does not contain the modified region, so the changed row is only visible in the patch excerpt. I examined the base units for context; they are unchanged by this PR.

Security relevance: this adds no code and no new trust boundary. A load-time warmup toggle could affect TTFT/latency characteristics, which is loosely related to the T-041 TTFT timing oracle. But it concerns model shape warmup, not prefix-cache hit/miss behavior, and the documented values do not alter cache scoping, TTL, HMAC lookup tags, encryption, attestation or authorization. The variable is a local operator-controlled setting. Whether it is forwarded into launchd is implied by the table it sits in, but this is not verified in the supplied evidence.

Remaining unverified: the actual implementation in ModelCalibrationPolicy.swift was not supplied, so it cannot be confirmed that the documented semantics match the code (e.g., that 'always' skipping the shader-cache probe has no integrity impact on loaded artifacts). This is a documentation-accuracy question and not an identified regression. No threat-model update appears required.
